releases.body:
## What's Changed

### Features

- **redpill**: compose universal doctrine with software domain pack

### Documentation

- **redpill**: document the two-layer doctrine and evidence map

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #82 from klpanagi/feat/redpill-two-layer

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

## What's Changed

### Features

- **hooks**: enforce context ceiling with compress watchdog
- **config**: add dcp.watchdog settings and compress-watchdog hook name

### Documentation

- document the compress watchdog

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #81 from klpanagi/feat/compress-watchdog

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1

## What's Changed

### Features

- **redpill**: add the Matrixx manifesto and rename the mode

### Bug Fixes

- **agents**: rename oracle-prefixed symbols in merovingian definition
- **orchestration**: hooks and task tools hardening
- **orchestration**: background-agent lifecycle hardening
- **orchestration**: task-storage and session-memory hardening
- **hooks**: niobe, matrix-loop, and stop-continuation-guard fixes (B12-B14)
- **background-agent**: reconcile, lifecycle, revive, and wallclock fixes (B1-B3, B8-B11)
- **task-storage**: harden atomic writes, locking, and retry (B4-B7)

### Refactoring

- **categories**: rename built-in categories to a coherent Matrix theme
- **orchestration**: consolidate duplicated timeout literals
- **skills**: drop stale triage copies, add sync guard and suggested skills
- **agents**: restructure into definitions, registry, shared

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #80 from klpanagi/feat/redpill-manifesto
- Merge pull request #79 from klpanagi/feat/redpill-manifesto
- Merge pull request #78 from klpanagi/perf/orch-opts-1-6
- perf(orchestration): dedupe fetchSessionMessages
- perf(background-agent): single-pass handle restore, task lookup index, single-pass descendants, drop dead completionTimers
- Merge pull request #77 from klpanagi/fix/merovingian-oracle-naming
- Merge pull request #76 from klpanagi/refactor/agents-restructure
- Merge pull request #75 from klpanagi/fix/orchestration-robustness-1-10
- Merge pull request #74 from klpanagi/fix/orchestration-bugfixes-b1-b14

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0

## What's Changed

### Features

- **agents**: harden keymaker directives with smith chain and infra track
- **agents**: add buildSmithSection prompt builder
- **background-agent**: unified parent notification with native wake

### Refactoring

- **tasks**: relocate enforcer helpers to task-session-scope
- **skills**: group skills into category subfolders

### Documentation

- drop README acknowledgment and remove stale port/migration plans
- refresh all docs to v1.2.1 codebase state
- **agents**: refresh all AGENTS.md files to match restructured codebase
- enforcer removal and unified parent notification

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #73 from klpanagi/docs/refresh-v1.2.1
- Fix formatting issues in README.md
- Merge pull request #72 from klpanagi/feat/keymaker-directives-harden
- Merge pull request #71 from klpanagi/docs/agents-md-refresh
- Merge origin/dev into docs/agents-md-refresh
- Merge pull request #70 from klpanagi/remove-enforcer-unified-bg-event
- Merge pull request #69 from klpanagi/restructure-readability
- Merge pull request #68 from klpanagi/feat/skills-tier1-reorg

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2

## What's Changed

### Features

- **category-skill-reminder**: pure nudge detector with 60s dedup wiring

### Bug Fixes

- **dcp**: bump generated schema URL to v3.2.0

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #67 from klpanagi/feat/wrong-tool-call-nudges
- Merge pull request #66 from klpanagi/fix/dcp-schema-3.2.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1
